name: Fearless (Taylor's Version)
llm_description: Fearless (Taylor's Version) is Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2008 breakthrough album, part of her effort to regain ownership of her masters, featuring re-recorded versions of the original tracks plus previously unreleased From the Vault songs.
llm_emotion_analysis: Romantic and nostalgic; youthful hopefulness revisited with mature reflection, alongside fresh material from the same era.
llm_overall_public_reception: Widely praised and commercially successful; became the first re-recorded album to top the Billboard 200, celebrated for reclaiming her catalog and the new Vault tracks.
